from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class ReceivableMetric(BaseModel):
    """A single accounts receivable data point extracted from a financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company filing the report")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact name of the receivable line item on the balance sheet")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numerical value of the receivables as reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit scale of the amount (e.g., 'thousands', 'millions')")
    period_end: str | None = Field(description="The end date of the reporting period")
    quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the amount and label")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    receivables_metrics: list[ReceivableMetric]
